title: Yaksha Prashna
notes: Ep 09/10 bar tokens. Comic mythology Amar Chitra — never photoreal. Vana Parva lake ordeal. Yudhishthira calm eldest; yaksha = luminous spirit later revealed as Dharma. Local locks under stills/_locks/ must be regenerated at 1536×1024 (current archive is 720p / wrong-aspect).

yudhishthira.face: Gentle eldest Pandava, light dark mustache, composed wise eyes, serene resolve — comic mythology, not photoreal
yudhishthira.hair: Black hair simple topknot — no peacock feather, no gold battle mukut
yudhishthira.costume: Cream or soft gold exile dhoti, modest dress, simple sacred thread

bhima.face: Powerful younger brother, broad jaw, thick dark mustache — comic mythology
bhima.costume: Saffron-yellow dhoti with gold border, bare powerful chest

arjuna.face: Young archer, thin dark mustache, focused calm — same face family as Ep 09 lock, comic mythology
arjuna.hair: Black warrior topknot — no peacock feather in exile
arjuna.costume: Cream-white exile dhoti with optional indigo trim — not gold battle armor

nakula_sahadeva.face: Younger twins, gentle features, light mustaches — comic mythology

yaksha.face: Luminous spirit face, stern calm — ethereal comic mythology, not gory monster
yaksha.hair: Crown of light or wild pale hair / mist
yaksha.costume: Glowing pale gold and mist-white robes, semi-divine presence over water
